gloss: beef tongue (esp. grilled, as a Sendai specialty)

definitions.explanation: Sliced beef tongue, usually salted and grilled over charcoal. It is the signature dish of {仙台|せんだい} and a standard item at yakiniku restaurants nationwide.

notes:
Written {牛|ぎゅう}タン, with タン from English "tongue." The all-kanji spelling {牛舌|ぎゅうぜつ} exists but is rare on menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛|ぎゅう}タン⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧: a beef tongue set meal (with barley rice and oxtail soup)
- ⟦{厚切|あつぎ}り→厚切り：07476_atsugiri⟧{牛|ぎゅう}タン: thick-cut beef tongue
- {牛|ぎゅう}タン⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧: salt-seasoned beef tongue, the standard preparation
- ⟦{仙台|せんだい}→仙台：30730_sendai⟧⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牛|ぎゅう}タン: Sendai's famous beef tongue

CULTURAL NOTE:
Grilled beef tongue was developed by a Sendai restaurateur after the war and is now the city's best-known souvenir food, sold vacuum-packed at ⟦{仙台|せんだい}→仙台：30730_sendai⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧. Ordering it as a set with {麦|むぎ}ごはん and テール⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧ is the local convention.
